cats.name: Popcat
cats.whoIsTheCat: Oatmeal, a real domestic short-haired cat owned by Twitter user @XavierBFB. In October 2020 two photos of him, one calm and one edited into a huge 'O' mouth, were shared on Discord. A friend's edit reached r/MEOW_IRL on Oct 9 and Twitter on Oct 10, 2020, becoming the 'Pop Cat' meme and, in December 2020, the popcat.click game.

virality.summary: The two-frame 'pop' loop spread from Reddit to Twitter in October 2020, then became lip-sync edits on Instagram and iFunny ('wide-mouth singing cat'). popcat.click, built on Dec 11, 2020 by three University of Sheffield students, turned it into a country-vs-country clicking race: Brazil (Feb 2021), Finland (Apr 2021, where schools banned it), then Taiwan, Thailand and Malaysia (Aug 2021). Google's 2021 Year in Search listed Popcat as the top trending game.
virality.metrics: Viral repost by @partitiongal on Oct 10, 2020: over 1.6M views, 57.1K retweets, 161.6K likes (Know Your Meme). popcat.click: 116B clicks by Aug 16, 2021 (Know Your Meme); live leaderboard 660,067,938,108 pops across 238 country/region codes, led by Thailand 126.4B, Hong Kong 123.7B, Taiwan 121.8B (leaderboard.popcat.click, read 2026-09-25 20:24 UTC). CoinGecko: 60,161 watchlist users. X @popcatworld: 1,471 followers (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25).

coin.launched: 2023-12-12 (first Raydium POPCAT/SOL pool, 21:04 UTC, per DexScreener)
coin.launchpad: None: direct Raydium pool on Solana (predates pump.fun); community-run after holders ousted the original developer in Dec 2023
coin.endorsedByOwner: No. No reliable source shows Oatmeal's owner (@XavierBFB) endorsing the coin. The project calls itself 100% community-owned (about.popcatsolana.xyz).

cats.lore: Oatmeal never set out to be famous. In October 2020 a friend of his human turned two snapshots of him, one calm and one with a comically round 'O' mouth, into a looping gif, and the internet began singing through him. Within weeks he was lip-syncing to every song imaginable. That December three University of Sheffield students built popcat.click, and whole countries raced to pop him the most, with Taiwan, Thailand and Hong Kong trading the top spot. Hundreds of billions of pops later, the little white cat with the tabby cap is still the internet's favourite click.

look.poseHint: Sit upright facing the viewer, head tilted slightly up; animate the mouth snapping open and shut on click, with a pop sound.

cats.name: Toshi
cats.whoIsTheCat: Toshi is one of the real cats of Coinbase co-founder and CEO Brian Armstrong (the other is Mochi). Armstrong said on a podcast that the name comes from Bitcoin's creator Satoshi Nakamoto, and Coinbase's first wallet was also called Toshi. In summer 2023 the Base community turned the name into a blue cartoon cat, 'the Face of Base'.

virality.summary: TOSHI caught on before Base's public mainnet launch in August 2023. CoinDesk reported it emerging as the leading meme coin on the new network, with traders swapping it on SushiSwap. After a relaunch to the current contract (Oct 2023) and a MeowDAO vote to drop the token tax, the blue cat became Base's best-known mascot, with NFToshis, merch and the Toshi Mart launchpad. Coinbase added it to its listing roadmap in January 2025 and began supporting TOSHI on Base on Jan 22-23, 2025.
virality.metrics: About $10M traded on SushiSwap in 24h, with over $1M of ETH liquidity, on Aug 4, 2023 (CoinDesk). X @Toshi: 108,887 followers, account created Jul 14, 2023 (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25). CoinGecko: 89,122 watchlist users. Listed on Coinbase, Kraken, Upbit, Bithumb and others (toshithecat.com exchange list).

coin.launched: Summer 2023 on Base: X account created 2023-07-14; trading on SushiSwap by 2023-08-04 (CoinDesk). The current contract's first pools date from 2023-10-09 (DexScreener) after the migration described in the project docs.
coin.launchpad: None: launched directly on SushiSwap (Base), later migrated to Uniswap V3 pools
coin.endorsedByOwner: No. No reliable source shows Brian Armstrong endorsing the coin. Coinbase the exchange lists TOSHI (Jan 2025), and toshithecat.com shows an ended 'Coinbase One x TOSHI' soulbound NFT mint. That is exchange and partner activity, not an owner endorsement.

cats.lore: Toshi is a real cat belonging to Coinbase co-founder Brian Armstrong, who also has a cat named Mochi. The name is a nod to Satoshi Nakamoto, Bitcoin's mysterious creator, and Coinbase's very first wallet app was also called Toshi. When Base, Coinbase's own network, opened in the summer of 2023, its early community drew Toshi as a laid-back blue cat in an orange hoodie and crowned it the Face of Base. Since then the blue cat has turned up all over Base culture, in art, NFToshis, merch and the MeowDAO where holders vote.

cats.name: Mog Coin
cats.whoIsTheCat: Joycat is Mog Coin's own cartoon mascot, not a real pet: the laughing 'cat with tears of joy' emoji face in mirrored shield sunglasses, often pointing at you. It comes from the slang 'to mog' (to outshine someone), which came out of 4chan around 2016. The community adopted it after the coin's fair launch on Ethereum on July 19, 2023.

virality.summary: Mog grew from a group-chat joke among Milady NFT community members (Decrypt) into what it calls 'the internet's first culture coin'. The laughing cat in pit-viper glasses plus the 🫵😹 emoji combo became shorthand for 'mogging'. The meme broke out of crypto on May 4, 2025, when Elon Musk added pit-viper sunglasses to his X profile picture. Garry Tan, Bryan Johnson, Reid Hoffman and Guillaume Verdon followed ('mog/acc'), and the Pit Viper brand began engaging with the community.
virality.metrics: X @mogcoin: 124,233 followers, account created Jul 19, 2023 (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25). Decrypt: the ninth-largest meme coin by market cap in July 2024, and a first $1B market cap in November 2024. CoinGecko: 52,271 watchlist users. Listed on Coinbase, Kraken, Bybit and others (mogcoin.xyz).

coin.launched: 2023-07-19 (Decrypt); first Uniswap V2 Mog/WETH pool created 2023-07-20 03:06 UTC (DexScreener)
coin.launchpad: None: Uniswap V2 fair launch on Ethereum (mogcoin.xyz)
coin.endorsedByOwner: Not applicable. Joycat is the community's own mascot, built from emoji, with no outside cat owner. The site says there is 'no formal team or roadmap'; Decrypt names a pseudonymous founder, 'Aug'. The Pit Viper sunglasses brand engaged with the community in May 2025 and is listed under the site's collabs, but that is a brand collab, not an endorsement by a cat's owner.

cats.lore: Joycat was born laughing. In the summer of 2023 a group of friends took the internet slang 'mog', meaning to effortlessly outshine, and turned it into a coin on Ethereum. The community gave it a face: the tears-of-joy cat emoji in a pair of mirrored shield sunglasses, usually pointing right at you. The idea is simple: stay unbothered, enjoy everything, always be mogging. In May 2025 the look escaped crypto altogether, when Elon Musk, Garry Tan and other tech figures put the same sunglasses on their profile pictures.

cats.name: cat in a dogs world
cats.whoIsTheCat: Mew is an original cartoon character, not a real pet: a white cat with a smug, half-lidded stare who, in the project's story, lives in Dog City and sets out to end the long rule of the dogs. Mew was created for the Solana coin 'cat in a dogs world', launched in March 2024, and later developed into a 3D animated series with LOCUS Animation Studios.

virality.summary: MEW launched as a cat-versus-dogs story at the height of Solana's dog-coin craze. 90% of the liquidity was burned and 10% of the supply was airdropped to the Solana community, and Bitfinex reported about $150M in trading within hours. The team built out the character with 'Mew Tails' stories, an appearance at Anime NYC, and a 3D animated series with LOCUS Animation Studios (Red Shoes, Yumi's Cells) about Mew and Rat in Dog City.
virality.metrics: X @mew: 121,432 followers, account created Mar 7, 2024 (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25). About $150M in transaction value within hours of launch (Bitfinex blog, reported). CoinGecko: 36,090 watchlist users. Supply fixed at 88,888,888,888.

coin.launchpad: None: direct Raydium pool on Solana, with 90% of the LP burned and 10% of the supply airdropped
coin.endorsedByOwner: Not applicable. Mew is the project's own original character; the IP sits with the MEW project, which runs the site and the LOCUS collaboration.

cats.lore: In a world run by dogs, one small white cat decided enough was enough. Mew lives in Dog City, where 'Shibatoni' and his henchmen have ruled for too long, and with a sleepy, knowing stare Mew sets out to wake everyone from the dog-world dream. The coin, 'cat in a dogs world', arrived on Solana in March 2024 with 90% of its liquidity burned and a tenth of the supply airdropped to the Solana community. Mew's story has since grown into the Mew Tails stories and a 3D animated series with LOCUS Animation Studios, following Mew and Rat through Dog City.
